description:
Spec: draft-atwood-jmap-chat-00 §3 (capability object).

Current state: crate-jmap-chat-client/src/session.rs ChatCapability struct has max_body_bytes, max_attachment_bytes, max_attachments_per_message, supports_threads, but is MISSING supportedBodyTypes.

Spec mandate: server MUST advertise the list of supported message bodyTypes. MUST include "text/plain". SHOULD include "text/markdown" (RFC 7763 CommonMark) and "application/jmap-chat-rich". E2EE deployments SHOULD include "application/mls-ciphertext". MAY include "application/mimi-content".

## Acceptance

- crate-jmap-chat-client/src/session.rs ChatCapability gains `pub supported_body_types: Vec<String>` field with #[serde(default)]
- Field is documented with spec cite (draft-atwood-jmap-chat-00 §3)
- The four existing field-extras tests are joined by a test asserting supported_body_types round-trips
- Doc-comment notes that an empty vec from a server is non-compliant per spec (text/plain MUST be present) but the client tolerates it via Default

## Out of scope

- Validating supported_body_types content (consumer's job; this is the wire shape)
- Adding equivalent server-side advertisement helper (no JMAP session capability advertisement code lives in the kit)
title: Layer A: Add supportedBodyTypes field to ChatCapability
